# Free Degree Library
> Free Study Materials & PYQs

Free Degree Library is a student-powered platform for Degree & PG level students to share and access academic materials, notes, assignments, and PYQs (Previous Year Questions) for free.

## Key Sections
- [Home](https://degreelibrary.gt.tc/) : Home page to search and download study materials.
- [Upload](https://degreelibrary.gt.tc/upload.html) : Upload new study materials.
- [Community](https://degreelibrary.gt.tc/community.html) : Student discussion forum.
- [MCA](https://degreelibrary.gt.tc/mca.html) : MCA specific resources.
- [ICET](https://degreelibrary.gt.tc/icet.html) : ICET PYQs and preparation materials.

## Technical Details
- Materials are categorized by tags (e.g., Computers, Java, Python, Business).
- Users can download files or share direct links to specific materials.
- It provides email and browser notifications for new content.
